description: Optional reminders without the app sending anything: the app builds a calendar file (.ics) on the phone and the parent adds it to their own calendar. The calendar app sends the reminders.
offer_when: On 'How you'll do it', the last step of the fast start (both reminders created with one button)
intro: Want a reminder? We can create calendar entries for you to add to your own calendar. Nothing is sent from this app.

choices.label: Weekly check-in
choices.note: Fast start: same weekday as the start date, one week later, at default_time.

choices.label: Daily practice time
choices.note: On by default in the fast start, at the time chosen on the How screen.

practice.title: Coach: practice time
practice.note: Use the parent's practice-plan time as the default time if they gave a clock time.

privacy_note: Calendar entries may sync to your calendar provider (for example Google or Apple), so they only say 'Coach' and never mention your child or your answers.

after_download.ios: Tap the downloaded file, then 'Add All'.
after_download.android: Open the downloaded file with your calendar app. If your calendar can't open it, set a weekly reminder yourself: we'll show you the day and time you picked.
after_download.update: If you repeat a module, your plan moves back a week but calendar entries don't change. You can delete them and create new ones from Settings.

tech_notes: Generate the .ics as a Blob and download it with an <a download> link: no network request, so it works with connect-src 'none'. Use the phone's local time zone (TZID). Test on both iPhone (Safari and installed app) and Android before the friend launch.
android_method: Chrome on Android: open the calendar app's 'new event' screen through an intent link, one per reminder, with title, start time and repeat filled in. Fallback: the .ics file.
